    • openFile

      Optional<Path> openFile(List<FileType> types)
      Asks for a file to open. Each type is a filter, in order, the first one selected, beside the chooser's "All files" filter; no type offers that filter only. The chooser starts in the directory last chosen in a chooser of this window, else in the user's home directory.
      Parameters:
      types - the types of files
      Returns:
      the chosen file, empty if the user cancelled
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if types or a type is null

    • saveFile

      Optional<Path> saveFile(List<FileType> types, String suggestedName)
      Asks for a file to save to, starting with a suggested name. A name without one of the selected type's extensions gets its first one; with the "All files" filter, the name stays as typed. A file that already exists asks whether to replace it before the chooser closes. The chooser starts as openFile(List) does.
      Parameters:
      types - the types of files
      suggestedName - the name the chooser starts with
      Returns:
      the chosen file, empty if the user cancelled
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if an argument or a type is null

    • askSave

      SaveChoice askSave(String documentName)
      Asks whether to save the changes of a document, with Save, Don't Save and Cancel buttons. Enter is Save; Escape and closing the dialog are Cancel.
      Parameters:
      documentName - the document's name
      Returns:
      the button chosen
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if documentName is null

    • chooseCommand

      Optional<PaletteEntry> chooseCommand(List<PaletteEntry> entries)
      Shows the command palette over the window: an undecorated modal dialog with a field and the entries the field's text matches, as CommandPalette.search(List, String) ranks them. Typing filters; Up and Down move the selection; Enter chooses the selected entry; Escape, and the dialog losing the focus, cancel.
      Parameters:
      entries - the entries, in the order of CommandPalette.entries()
      Returns:
      the entry chosen, or empty when the user cancels
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if entries is null
